metadata.purpose: Full 34-cell SHT FFT-target comparison of N=1442 radix-103 per-transform root-pair precomputation against M26
metadata.candidate_source_base: RustSHT-FFT M26 commit 5d9264871972756a6cd7323e99e5a938b7e3040a plus the M28 source change
metadata.workload: All 34 current C2C and real SHT-target operation/length cells; one-transform and scalar/spin-1 row batches; one transform thread
metadata.timing: Six alternating process pairs; seven warmed samples per operation
metadata.compiler: Rust 1.99.0 stable; optimized bench profile; portable x86_64 target; runtime AVX2 dispatch
metadata.cpu_model: AMD Ryzen 9 5950X; process pinned to logical CPU 30
metadata.dispatch_note: The f64 N=1442 radix-103 AVX2 pass precomputes its 25 adjacent-frequency root pairs once per call; unsafe inverse input, f32, and non-AVX2 dispatch remain unchanged.
metadata.runner: benches/results/m24-radix103/run_m24_clean_capture.py records process IDs, uptime, and load averages before, during, and after each run, and fsyncs every JSONL record.
